baseline.title: The Crownless Coast - armarium25-example - Obsidian 1.13.7
baseline.text:
The Crownless Coast
Properties
types/Content
campaign_1
Location
A chain of independent harbor towns joined by trade, rivalry and a shared refusal of hereditary tolls.
Add property
Notes

The coast follows a long arc of red limestone cliffs and sheltered inlets. Its
harbor towns elect their own councils and bargain over pilotage, salvage and
convoy rights. A council can command its quays; beyond the harbor markers, its
orders carry only as far as a willing crew will take them.

Olives, citrus peel, sailcloth and copper move between the ports. Storm season
closes the exposed passages, making pilot knowledge a source of political power.
Port Briselle guards one of the safer anchorages.

Dress and public ceremony matter: captains display their ship's colors at a
hearing, and a glove laid on a negotiating table announces a challenge. A challenge
may be answered with steel, a race, or terms witnessed before the harbor bell.

A broken ridge of red reefs off [[Port Briselle|Briselle]], passable through shifting tidal channels.

Notes

At low water the reef crowns resemble teeth above white surf. Between them lie
three narrow channels, two usable by shallow-draft cutters and one deep enough for
a laden merchantman at the right tide. A lookout can hear the outer breakers long
before seeing land in fog.

The Free Pilots Assembly maintains the channel knowledge for vessels
leaving Port Briselle. The reefs lie beyond the harbor authority's
markers; pilots treat promises made there as personal obligations.
